name: poiesis-design
description: Design toolkit for Claude Code: poiesis-ui (how an interface looks), poiesis-ux (how an app behaves) and poiesis-components (the component set built on both).

plugins.name: poiesis-ui
plugins.description: How your interface looks: text sizes, hierarchy, spacing, color and shape (corners, lines, shadows), all derived from a few values you choose, in a preset and a style. Rules, an auditor that checks your code, and a gate that holds back publishing until the check passes.

plugins.name: poiesis-ux
plugins.description: How your app behaves for the people using it: rules for feedback, errors, control, keyboard use and wording, and a tester that does your app's main tasks the way a person would and reports what gets in their way.

plugins.name: poiesis-components
plugins.description: The Poiesis component set: shadcn/ui components themed by poiesis-ui's poiesis.css, copied into a React + Tailwind project; change the theme, preset or style and every component follows. Shown in poiesis-gallery.
